Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Illinois Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for IPP & CHP?

A. 180,768,307 megawatthours
B. 4,244,628 megawatthours

Source citation: Illinois Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/illinois/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: B
